album_art_names.description: album_art_names (as documented in the shipped file).

db_dir.description: Directory to store the metadata database and thumbnail cache. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#db_dir=/var/cache/minidlna).

enable_subtitles.description: enable_subtitles (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#enable_subtitles=yes).

enable_tivo.description: enable_tivo (as documented in the shipped file).

force_sort_criteria.description: force_sort_criteria (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#force_sort_criteria=+upnp:class,+upnp:originalTrackNumber,+dc:title).

friendly_name.description: Name of the DLNA/UPnP server as advertised on the network. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#friendly_name=My DLNA Server).

http_port.description: TCP port for HTTP media streaming and web UI (if enabled).

inotify.description: Enable inotify-based automatic updates when media files change.

interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., 'eth0'); leave empty to bind to all interfaces. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#network_interface=eth0).

log_dir.description: Directory to store runtime log files. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_dir=/var/log/minidlna).

log_level.description: log_level (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_level=general,artwork,database,inotify,scanner,metadata,http,ssdp,tivo=warn).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_connections=50).

media_dir.description: media_dir (as documented in the shipped file).

merge_media_dirs.description: merge_media_dirs (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#merge_media_dirs=no).

minissdpdsocket.description: minissdpdsocket (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#minissdpdsocket=/var/run/minissdpd.sock).

model_number.description: Model number advertised in UPnP device description.

notify_interval.description: notify_interval (as documented in the shipped file).

presentation_url.description: presentation_url (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#presentation_url=http://www.mylan/index.php).

root_container.description: Root container to display at top level: '.' (root), 'F' (filesystem), 'M' (music), 'V' (video), 'P' (pictures). Must be one of '.', 'F', 'M', 'V', 'P', 'B'. Note: 'B' is not in the original default config (commented out .), but 'B' is allowed in the schema. The default in the real file is commented out as ., so we use '.'. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#root_container=.).

serial_number.description: Serial number advertised in UPnP device description. Defaults to MAC address if empty.

strict_dlna.description: Enable strict DLNA compliance (disables some non-standard but widely used features).

tivo_discovery.description: tivo_discovery (as documented in the shipped file).

user.description: User the daemon should run as (sysV init only; systemd uses unit override). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#user=jmaggard).

wide_links.description: wide_links (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#wide_links=no).
